title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E01 — The Good, the Bad and the Unlucky
As the Golden Nugget's busiest season begins, tempers flare at check-in; a swiped $1,000 chip sparks a hotel-wide high-tech hunt; surveillance targets a team of card counters; and a VIP host gets creative to keep his client gambling.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E07 — Fifty Shades of Gray
With unprecedented access, the Golden Nugget reveals the hidden world behind a Las Vegas hotel and casino, where a larger-than-life team of security, surveillance, operations and VIP hosts manage the chaos of wild guest requests and bad behavior.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E04 — Nightmare on Fremont Street
A rookie security manager on his first graveyard shift struggles to keep up with an escalating barrage of bizarre calls, ringing one after another; meanwhile, a late-night VIP pickup turns into a cross-town odyssey full of unexpected detours.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E03 — Sex, Lies and Surveillance Tape
A hotel guest reports a theft that launches an investigation with security and Metro detectives, but the truth proves to be far more scandalous.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E01 — The Good, the Bad and the Unlucky

title: Gold Rush: Parker's Trail
description:
S06 E08 — There's Gold Everywhere
Parker strikes gold in Bolivia at a location that could be the next Klondike; with time running out on his prospect, Parker faces a big decision.

title: Gold Rush: Dave Turin's Lost Mine
description:
S01 E01 — Dozer Dave Returns
Former "Gold Rush" miner Dave Turin sets out on his own prospecting for an abandoned gold mine to reopen; when an investor backs out, Dave has to decide if he's willing to risk his family's life savings on his ability to bring home the gold.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E06 — Up in Smoke
When their hillbilly scotch experiment flames out, Mark and Digger light a fire under their still hand, Kelly. Josh's lucrative 80-gallon moonshine order rides on Jerry's unproven vacuum still experiment. Mike devises a recipe to poach Jerry's buyer.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E07 — Shiner Patriot
For America's 250th anniversary, Tim and Tickle produce revolutionary-era moonshine; Digger questions Mark's attempt at his ancestor's sour corn whiskey; Josh and Jerry's plans fail.

title: Guided: The Reel Story of Louisiana Guides
description:
S01 E02
Science, saltwater and sportsmen; our friends at Louisiana Wildlife and Fisheries take guided aboard the stingray -- the state's new saltwater electrofishing boat -- to show how cutting-edge science helps manage the fish that guides.

title: Tomorrow's World Today
description:
S10 E07 — Clearly Visionary
George sends Greg to the World of Production to uncover how cutting-edge automotive glass engineering is transforming modern vehicles and powering tomorrow's mobility marvels.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E08 — Carrying Parker's Water
Parker's team tries a wild plan to resupply their water; Tony struggles with a rock truck driver; Rick gets test results on his Snake River cut.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S03 E07 — Reading Between the Lies
A new officer makes one of the biggest drug busts her bridge has ever seen; a group of biology students returning from Mexico is carrying something unexpected in their trunk; a pedestrian attempts to conceal something valuable under his clothing.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E11 — Grandma's Day Out
A truck carrying household goods into Mexico is stopped for inspection; when several boxes are X-rayed, a gun and ammunition are found hidden inside a kids' toy box; a man re-entering the U.S. is stopped after checks reveal he is wanted for murder.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S05 E05 — The Cartel Games
Officers investigate a man crossing with a statue of Santa Muerte, deemed the patron saint of drug smugglers; a band's tour bus is flagged when an X-ray reveals a dark object in its fuel tank; a K9 alerts to the car of a felonious traveler.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S05 E10 — Does Your Wife Know?
Officers target SUVs that are notorious for concealing drugs; two wanted cartel members are extradited back to Mexico; officers struggle to open up an engine part that they think is hiding drugs; a woman smuggling diet pills is caught in the act.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E10 — Grinding to a Halt
Officers spot a lone pedestrian entering the U.S. with large bags; the search reveals containers of coffee, one concealing a package of suspected narcotics; the x-ray of a flatbed trailer reveals hidden bundles, but officers struggle to reach them.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S07 E01 — Seedy Behavior
When an older couple crossing into the US has cartel logos on their packed clothes, they have some explaining to do; a Mexican driver says he's visiting a friend in Texas, but seems nervous; a vehicle search finds evidence of hidden compartments.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description:
S03 E01 — Outback Trial by Fire
In the Australian Outback, 14 of "Naked and Afraid's" best, including Laura, Matt, Ky and Max, vie for the title.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description:
S03 E02 — A Thief in the Night
Shocking sabotage and a midnight medical emergency upend the competition; the elimination challenge requires a photo finish; in a test of skills, survivalists must build primitive ladders, torches and hooks to claim critical caches.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description:
S03 E03 — Scared and Snared Down Under
While tracking a wild boar, Laura discovers an animal nest and to avoid elimination, camps scramble to build baited spring snare traps; tensions rise when Patrick questions Jermaine's hunting tactics; one competitor is eliminated.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description:
S03 E04 — All Shelter Breaks Loose
Under the sweltering Outback sun, competitors scramble to build Aboriginal dome shelters and avoid elimination; medics race to give aid when Laura suffers whiplash, and Trish gets toxic sap in her eye; a survivalist must be evacuated via stretcher.

title: Bering Sea Gold
description:
S17 E07 — Out of Their Depths
A potential disaster plagues the Kellys, prompting a bail-out from Chris McCully; Shawn and Vernon try their luck in deeper waters; Team Emily strives for a double dive.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E01 — Living Life on the Edge
A damaged hauler carrying U.S. mail through Colorado shuts down I-70; hurricane-force winds in Wyoming leave a semi skewered; a jackknife on an icy overpass in Utah has the recovery crew at odds.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E06 — The Midnight Storm
Big Al's Towing races the clock as a semi carrying an expensive frozen load overturns on I-80.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E03 — Avalanche Country
Competing companies team up to recover a fully loaded cement truck leaking natural gas; Big Jon heads into avalanche country to rescue a stuck semi carrying hazardous goods; during a sudden blizzard, a crash in Salt Lake City leaves a semi in pieces.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E02 — The Tunnel of Chaos
The I-70 Eisenhower Tunnel closes in both directions as a 78-vehicle pileup creates mass chaos; Mountain Recovery and Stauffer's Towing battle high winds and slick roads to clear wreckage and keep major highways moving.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E07 — Spinning Out on I-80
A windstorm near Salt Lake City overturns a semi with a mystery load; a hauler with a heavy-duty load of data center cooling units spins out of control on I-80; Mountain Recovery's rookie operator fights a multi-front battle.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E03 — Suffolk County Correctional Facility
As an opioid epidemic grips the county, a law-and-order sheriff uses rehabilitation to help inmates break the cycle of addiction while officers work around the clock to maintain safety, security and order inside one of New York's busiest jails.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E01 — Clay County Detention Center
In Clay County, Mississippi, where gun deaths are an epidemic and the median income sits 66% below the national average, Sheriff Scott and his team fight to keep order inside a jail where the consequences of a community in crisis arrive daily.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E06 — Flagler County Jail
At Florida's Flagler County Jail, law and order Sheriff Rick Staly takes a tough approach to corrections while battling the revolving door of repeat offenders through discipline, rehabilitation, and recovery programs.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E02 — Leake County Jail
In rural Leake County, Mississippi, a small jail battles a big meth problem; with repeat offenders entering the jail daily, local law enforcement works to break the cycle.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E06 — Bristol County Jail
In Bristol County Jail, half of the cells don't lock; as changing demographics bring in more violent, gang-affiliated criminals, staff must manage a higher-risk population without the facility slipping into chaos.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S02 E12 — From Lies to Leads
After two unclaimed cargo packages are opened, experts are called in after officers suspect that they may contain stolen ancient artifacts.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S01 E04 — It's Not Supposed to Be Sticky
While officers inspect a cargo shipment for illegal marijuana, an X-ray reveals some lewd contents; a character attracts officers' attention for bringing medications they suspect he intends to sell at an alternative lifestyle festival.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S02 E08 — Bulking Up
A passenger arriving from Cairo has brought some extra carry-ons that interest officers; an American fashion designer returning from Paris fails to declare nearly $20,000 worth of luxury goods; a bag of snails from West Africa raises suspicions.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S02 E07 — My Brother's Timekeeper
Rising tariffs tempt some citizens to go abroad to buy luxury goods, where items can be up to 40% cheaper, then bring them home without paying the proper duties; a traveler returning from Italy claims she has a $50,000 watch belonging to her brother.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
description:
S02 E06 — Coming to America
A man is referred for questioning after failing to declare the full contents of his luggage, which contains a half-cooked Ghanaian delicacy.

title: All Access PD: Grand Rapids
description:
S01 E06 — The Girl on the Scooter
A bullet kills 15-year-old La'Kyijah Williams, outraging Chief Eric Winstrom; CCTV shows a masked gunman, but witnesses refuse to talk until a tip names a suspect; when officers arrest him at a traffic stop, detectives don't have enough evidence.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E02 — The Rat Pack
When a drug dog alerts a vehicle full of clubbers heading to a techno bar, officers find the group has gotten creative with their illicit drugs; officers inspecting a couple's truck find bags full of rat carcasses to be used in a specialty soup.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S03 E09 — The Hitman
Agricultural inspectors intercept nearly 50 gallons of illicit moonshine; a former cartel hitman is extradited back to Mexico; a random vehicle inspection turns up a major seizure; a woman is caught attempting to smuggle prescription meds.

description:
S17 E08 — No Sleep Till Landfall
As the countdown to the storm of the century begins, the fleet races to mine; Reaper Nation hits deeper waters while Shawn, Emily, Vernon and Chris all fight large swells to get gold until the bitter end.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E06 — Rocked to the Core
When a rogue wave pummels the Wizard and sidelines its crew, Keith reconsiders the risks he's taking; racing to make an offload, Sig loses a deckhand to a crushed toe.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E07 — Wrong Side of the Law
When Monte discovers Keith set pots in an illegal zone, he and the Wizard crew must pay the price in blood and treasure; a storm reconnects Jake to the larger-than-life hero of the Cornelia Marie's past.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E08 — Anything That Can Go Wrong
When Sig's crane blows a hydraulic line, Clark ascends the rig in 20-foot seas for a critical repair; the Cornelia Marie crew battles a fire as Jake's engine room fills with smoke.

title: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine
description:
S02 E06 — Bones in the Backwoods
When a moonshine kingpin murdered a rogue bootlegger in 1948, fear kept witnesses silent.

title: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine
description:
S02 E03 — Seaside Speakeasy Conspiracy
Mark, Digger and Tim investigate a Prohibition-era speakeasy in Connecticut that served bootleg liquor to the hottest celebrities of the day; when New York's mobsters come calling, glamour gives way to gunplay, federal agents close in.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E06 — The Bumper Sticker Brawl
Tizzy investigates an assault triggered by a bumper sticker; a judge dishes out justice for an attack on a fast food worker, and a couple of road rage incidents have Tizzy fired up.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E04 — The Mystery Pistol Packer
Tizzy tries to identify a man filmed pulling a gun on skateboarders; a road rager who reportedly used his coffee cup as a weapon is identified by his tattoos; a confrontation over a car charger leaves a woman seeking Tizzy's help.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E07 — Road Rage on the Underage
Tizzy investigates a driver who violently assaults a teenage boy riding a bike; a customer catches a brazen shoplifter, and a woman nearly runs over her boyfriend at a gas station.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E05 — The Nightmare Neighbor
Tizzy sparks an internet movement to end a woman's racially charged harassment of her neighbors; a parking lot guard is targeted by a driver; a disgruntled customer wrecks a GameStop.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E08 — Beverly Hills Banger
Tizzy investigates a frightening confrontation between a man and a pair of Beverly Hills reality show stars; a woman allegedly pepper sprays another driver for going too slowly, and a delivery person busts up a Taco Bell.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E04 — Digger Knows Best
Facing more demand for corn liquor than he can handle, Josh turns to Digger for help. Tim and Tickle discover their oddball neighbor is running an illegal moonshine operation of his own.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E05 — Hillbilly Scotch
Josh's head spins when Jerry reveals his wild plans for their joint moonshine operation. Mark and Digger enlist a Scotsman to help craft the first Hillbilly Scotch.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E08 — Mash Bill of Rights
As Tim and Tickle add molasses to their 18th-century mash bill and heat their vintage copper still with wood fire, Howard takes the revolutionary spirit too far. Demand for Josh's shine outpaces supply as Jerry opens a new front in his war with Mike.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E08 — All Slot and Bothered
A high roller demands the return of his favorite slot machine as security goes undercover to catch hustlers targeting casino guests. Meanwhile, a poolside confrontation spirals out of control, stretching the Golden Nugget team thin.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E08 — The Maine State of Cash
In the largest hoard he's ever tackled, Matt must find rare military plane parts, vintage records and a hidden jewelry cache to have a shot at making a profit; he brings in heavy equipment to clear the property and dig for big-ticket items.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E13 — From Rats to Riches
Matt's team goes full hazmat suit to tackle a rat-infested hoard that is rumored to have cash hidden in every room, if the rats haven't eaten it already; the team also hunts for vintage Playboys, a rare samurai sword and original G.I. Joe toys.

S17 E09 — Apocalypse Nome
As the miners try to secure their operations, a catastrophic storm rips through Nome, devastating the community and leaving it forever changed.

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E03 — Blackbeard's Ghost
Heather and Phil explore Ocracoke Island, where locals fear the ghost of Blackbeard is lingering; is the pirate's restless spirit protecting hidden treasure, or seeking vengeance upon the living?

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E06 — Terrors of Trinidad
Reports of shadowy figures and malevolent spirits from Caribbean folklore draw Phil and Heather to Trinidad; they explore a notorious plantation and an abandoned island once used as a leper colony, searching for the source of the chilling activity.

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E07 — Nightmare Island
In Trinidad, Heather and Phil continue to confront terrifying claims of demonic possession and Obeah curses, tracing the sinister forces that locals say still grip the island.

title: Expedition X
description:
S10 E09 — The Bridgewater Triangle
Massachusetts' Bridgewater Triangle is America's leading hotspot for all things unexplained: UFOs, cryptids, and even supernatural encounters; Heather and Phil's investigation pushes them toward the center of the Triangle: the Hockomock Swamp.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S04 E05 — Dark Waters
Josh Gates investigates three aquatic mysteries: the Kraken, Lake Lanier and Atlantis; from terrifying sailor lore, to a deadly lake's dark past and a lost city beneath the sea, he searches for evidence.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S01 E02 — Monsters Unmasked
New evidence suggests Jack the Ripper's identity, while DNA analysis indicates possible Yeti existence; Max Headroom interrupts live broadcast, surprising everyone.
